values./items/@2TR0yWRaj0zGYgN8/system/effect: Combat Armor Chest Piece, Combat Armor Leg x2, Combat Armor Arm x2, Combat Rifle, Wealth 2
values./items/@xlqotTvCXVWMY9Ew/system/descript: A pre-War weapon found across the wastelands and used in large numbers by various aggressive factions. Combat Rifles are a rugged and adaptable design, able to be modified to fill a variety of different battlefield roles.
values./items/@yMYdVzXOmvX5WQEN/system/descript: Before the Great War, double-barrel shotguns were mainly used for hunting and home defense, and this has changed little. They are break-action and come in an either a side-by-side or over-and-under barrel configuration. Simple to make and maintain, these shotguns are seen frequently in the Commonwealth and the rest of the wasteland.
values./items/@zUfodpdE5WZldWoJ/system/descript: Consisting of a glass bottle—normally from an alcoholic beverage—containing a flammable fuel mixture, a bit of motor oil to help it spread, and an alcohol-soaked rag stuffed in the top to act as a wick. When used, the wick is ignited and the bottle hurled at the target; the breaking bottle spreads the agitated mixture, which quickly ignites begins to burn anything in the vicinity. Cheap and effective.
values./items/@7O8DC1WSGUsW8Fl3/system/descript: Once per combat, the mercenary may ‘let rip’ with a volley from their Combat Rifle. This adds the weapon’s Fire Rate of 2 to the weapon’s damage for a single attack (for 7 CD total).
values./system/biography: Sally Jessup after Zetan augmentation. Use the Core Mercenary profile with STR, END and AGI increased by 2, HP 18, Defense 2 and an XP reward of 90.
